GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (Taunt.cs:16) == the class attribute -- notable because Taunt is a SKILL that targets an enemy AND gains block, so neither the type nor the target type implies the flag.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Taunt.cs:26-29) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY -- another enemy-targeting Skill, like card/dark_shackles and card/dominate.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(7m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new PowerVar<VulnerablePower>(1m)` (Taunt.cs:18-22) == both numbers, both declared. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius.

OnPlay.issue: C# applies the debuff unconditionally and the only gate is `Creature.CanReceivePowers` (Creature.cs:308-321), whose doc comment states that DEAD creatures can still receive powers -- it refuses only for a REMOVED corpse. The two agree for an ordinary kill (`CreatureCmd.Damage` runs `Kill` before returning, CreatureCmd.cs:409, removal at 523-525) and diverge for a corpse whose removal was VETOED (`ShouldCreatureBeRemovedFromCombatAfterDeath`, CreatureCmd.cs:508; the sim's `retained_after_death`, cmds.py:100-104), because `is_gone` is `is_dead or escaped` (creatures.py:44-46). Observable through ViciousPower, which draws on any Vulnerable its owner applies with no liveness test on the target (ViciousPower.cs:19-26). Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bash's OnPlay entry (rule 3); LIVE. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/card_probes.py dead-target-guards` lists 41 sim card classes that test liveness. Block 7 FIRST then Vulnerable 1 -- amounts and order faithful (Taunt.cs:35-36). Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (34) and the Vulnerable hover tip (24).

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` + `DynamicVars.Vulnerable.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (Taunt.cs:41-42) == `_block += 1` (7 -> 8) and `_vulnerable += 1` (1 -> 2). Both upgraded numbers checked, and the +1 block is unusually small -- the common value is +3 -- so it is easy to transcribe wrongly.
